title: Status
description: Current A/B view exported by `recab status --json`.

committed.description:
The running slot is the known-good slot. After a trial boot this is
false until it is committed; an uncommitted slot is left on next boot.

last_trial.description: How the last judged trial boot ended.

next_boot.description: The slot the next boot starts: the trial slot, else the default.

rollback_slot.description: The slot `recab rollback` would select, if any.

slots.description: Each slot's entry, kernel directory and partition.

trial_pending.description: A one-shot trial boot is set in the firmware and not yet taken.

SlotView.description: One slot's layout on the ESP, as recab wrote it.

boot_dir.description: The directory of its kernel and initramfs, relative to the ESP.

bootable.description: Every file the entry loads is on the ESP.

device.description: The block device `root` names on this machine, if present.

entry.description: The entry file, relative to the ESP (`loader/entries/<prefix>-a.conf`).

root.description: The entry's `root=` (`PARTUUID=...`), if it has one.

trial.description:
The entry carries a trial's options (it was staged or scheduled and
not yet committed).

TrialRecord.description: How the last judged trial boot ended.

committed.description: The trial was healthy and committed; otherwise it was abandoned.

detail.description: How startup ended, and the failed units if any.
